description: Relay server for the LANCommander Interposer's network relay: carries games' LAN traffic (UDP, broadcast, IPX and TCP) between players over the internet without a VPN, and hands each player a virtual LAN address. Host it from a LANCommander server or any .NET process.
Parse, encrypt, decrypt, keypair, keyring and related primitives for .env files, ported from the @dotenvx/primitives npm package and matching it at the same version.
Look up dotenvx private keys in .env.keys, the OS secret store, Dotenvx Armor, 1Password and Bitwarden, ported from the @dotenvx/providers npm package and matching it at the same version.
Load, parse, get and set .env values (including encrypted ones) from .NET code: Dotenvx.Config(), Get(), Parse() and Set(), a port of the @dotenvx/dotenvx library API.
Adds .env files, encrypted ones included, to Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration with IConfigurationBuilder.AddDotenvx().

The dotenvx command-line tool for .NET: run any program with its .env files injected, with multiple environments and encrypted .env files. A port of @dotenvx/dotenvx, matching its CLI at the same version.

Typed, NativeAOT-friendly messaging over TCP. Send plain C# classes between .NET apps: a source generator discovers your message types and generates fast MemoryPack serializers, with TLS, broadcasts and compile-time checks built in.
